method: Use the existing season-summary opening scale: ceil((500000 + min(knownPoints / 913, 1) * 1500000) / 1000) * 1000. knownPoints = reported runs + 10 * (reported wickets + reported catches + reported stumpings). Missing statistics remain null, never reported as zero. Partial prices are provisional lower bounds from available season contributions. Players without usable season totals retain the authorised 100000 floor.
